roadmap.title: April to June: establish the routine
roadmap.description: Build Social Stats and start Social Links as they open. Keep rotating saves and carry matching Arcana Personas to meetings.

roadmap.title: Summer to September: expand the team
roadmap.description: Use Shinjiro’s Theurgy before October 4. Continue school links, requests and Tartarus exploration; rescue Bunkichi by October 4.

roadmap.title: October to December: preserve the ending route
roadmap.description: Rescue Maiko by November 3. Finish Elizabeth’s outings with three days between each. Save before December 31 and spare Ryoji.

roadmap.title: January: finish links and Tartarus
roadmap.description: Start Aigis on January 8. Complete all Social Links, defeat the Reaper and fuse Messiah before the January 31 final battle, then watch the good ending.

roadmap.title: Episode Aigis: complete the additional story
roadmap.description: Select Change Episode from the title screen. Complete Episode Aigis from the paid Expansion Pass; its eight achievements follow the story.

achievements.description: Awaken Orpheus during the main story.
achievements.summary: Awaken Orpheus during the main story.

steps.text: Play through the opening until the protagonist awakens @mechanic{Orpheus}.

achievements.description: Become a member of SEES.
achievements.summary: Become a member of SEES.

steps.text: Reach the story scene where the protagonist joins @mechanic{SEES}.

achievements.description: Win the main-story battle against Priestess.
achievements.summary: Win the main-story battle against Priestess.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Priestess} in the May 9 full-moon operation.

achievements.description: Win the main-story battle against Empress and Emperor.
achievements.summary: Win the main-story battle against Empress and Emperor.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Empress and Emperor} in the June 8 full-moon operation.

achievements.displayName: Never Toy with Matters of the Heart
achievements.description: Win the main-story battle against Hierophant and Lovers.
achievements.summary: Win the main-story battle against Hierophant and Lovers.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hierophant and Lovers} in the July 7 full-moon operation.

achievements.description: Win the main-story battle against Chariot and Justice.
achievements.summary: Win the main-story battle against Chariot and Justice.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Chariot and Justice} in the August 6 full-moon operation.

achievements.description: Win the main-story battle against Hermit.
achievements.summary: Win the main-story battle against Hermit.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hermit} in the September 5 full-moon operation.

achievements.description: Win the main-story battle against Fortune and Strength.
achievements.summary: Win the main-story battle against Fortune and Strength.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Fortune and Strength} in the October 4 full-moon operation.

achievements.description: Win the main-story battle against Hanged Man.
achievements.summary: Win the main-story battle against Hanged Man.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Hanged Man} in the November 3 full-moon operation.

achievements.description: Seal Nyx on the main story’s good-ending route.
achievements.summary: Seal Nyx on the main story’s good-ending route.

steps.text: Make a separate save before the December 31 decision, then @warn{spare Ryoji}. If you kill him, reload that save.
Finish the climb through @loc{Tartarus} on January 31 and defeat @enemy{Nyx}.

achievements.description: Watch the main story’s good ending.
achievements.summary: Watch the main story’s good ending.

steps.text: Save before the December 31 choice and spare @npc{Ryoji}; reload that save if you choose to kill him.
After sealing Nyx, play through the remaining scenes and watch the ending.

achievements.description: Obtained 10 Major Arcana during Shuffle Time.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Major Arcana cards through Shuffle Time in the main story.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Major Arcana} cards during Shuffle Time until you have collected 10.

achievements.description: Invited Elizabeth to your room.
achievements.summary: Invite Elizabeth into your room.

steps.text: Complete Elizabeth’s requests to unlock outings @mechanic{77–80}. Take outings 77–79 during the day and outing 80 after school. Complete the outings in order, with at least three days between them.
Keep completing requests until their Challenge Levels total at least 185 and @mechanic{request 81} becomes available.
After another three days, speak to @npc{Elizabeth} during the day and accept request 81 to show her your room.

achievements.description: Aced an exam.
achievements.summary: Finish an exam with the highest score.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{Academics rank 4} before July 14 and save before the exams.
Answer @mechanic{Dowsing} on July 14, @mechanic{An error in translation} on July 15, @mechanic{Taira No Masakado} on July 16 and @mechanic{Comma splice} on July 17.
Read the results on July 24. If you miss the top score, reload your pre-exam save or prepare for a later exam.

achievements.description: Maxed out all Social Links.
achievements.sortReason: Begin the dated calendar in April; finish the task in January.
achievements.summary: Raise every Social Link to rank 10 within one playthrough.

guide.context: Each link needs a matching-Arcana Persona on the meeting day for bonus points, so check your Personas before leaving Tartarus. Rewind only undoes the last five actions, so keep rotating manual saves; one lost meeting can leave too few days.

steps.text: Raise your three social stats on this timeline, because links need them: Courage 2 by April 26, 3 by May 10, 4 by May 25, 5 by June 5, 6 by June 19. Charm 2 by April 30, 3 by May 10, 4 by May 25, 5 by June 17, 6 by July 24. Academics 2 by May 1, 3 by May 17, 4 by July 13, 5 by August 18, 6 by October 29. Max Charm also multiplies link points.

Visit Tartarus on these days and carry these Personas by Arcana until the next visit. April 23: Hermit and Hanged Man. May 24: Justice and Strength. June 27: Magician, Priestess, Hermit, Hanged Man and Moon. August 3: Priestess, Strength, Justice, Tower, Star and Moon. September 4: Priestess, Lovers, Strength, Temperance and Tower. October 1: Priestess, Hierophant, Lovers, Star and Moon. November 2: Hierophant, Lovers and Chariot. November 29: Hierophant, Chariot, Hanged Man and Star. December 30: Star. Pick up an Odd Morsel from a chest in the first Tartarus visit for the Moon link.

April, rank-ups by date. 22 Magician 1. 23 Chariot 1. 24 Chariot 2, Strength 1. 25 Strength 2. 26 Hierophant 1. 27 Emperor 1. 28 Magician 2. 29 Hermit 1. 30 Magician 3. Also start Strength on April 23 and 24 by greeting Yuko and asking to walk home, and talk to Chihiro for Justice on April 28, April 30 and May 2.

May. 2 Hierophant 2. 3 Hermit 2. 4 Hermit 3. 5 Hierophant 3. 6 Hanged Man starts, Emperor 2. 7 Justice 1. 8 Magician 4, learn of the Gourmet King for Moon. 10 Hierophant 4. 11 Hanged Man 1. 13 Hanged Man 2. 14 Hierophant 5. 15 Moon 1. 16 Hanged Man 3. 17 Hermit 4. 23 Justice 2. 25 Emperor 3. 26 Justice 3, pay 20,000 yen to the man in the suit for the Devil link. 27 Strength 3. 28 Justice 4. 29 Temperance 1. 30 Strength 4, pay him 10,000 yen more.

June. 1 Emperor 4. 2 Devil 1 after a third 10,000 yen payment, Justice 5. 3 Strength 5, Tower starts. 4 Justice 6, Tower 1. 5 Emperor 5. 6 Strength 6, Tower 2. 7 Moon 2. 9 Justice 7. 10 Strength 7. 11 Chariot 3. 12 Temperance 2. 13 Strength 8. 15 Chariot 4. 16 Temperance 3. 17 Emperor 6. 18 Fortune 1, Tower 3. 19 Magician 5. 22 Priestess 1. 23 Justice 8. 24 Temperance 4. 25 Magician 6. 26 Priestess 2. 27 Priestess 3. 28 Hermit 5. 29 Priestess 4. 30 Temperance 5. Death advances with the story from June 12.

July. 1 Emperor 7. 2 Magician 7. 3 Priestess 5. 4 Priestess 6, Devil 2. 5 Hermit 6. 6 Priestess 7. 8 Hanged Man 4. 9 Moon 3. 10 Moon 4. 11 Hanged Man 5, Devil 3. 12 Hermit 7. 13 Hanged Man 6. 19 Hermit 8. 24 Magician 8. 25 Lovers 1, Devil 4. 26 Hermit 9. 28 Devil 5. 31 Tower 4.
August. 3 Hanged Man 7. 4 Moon 5, Devil 6. 5 Star 1. 7 Star 2, Tower 5. 8 Moon 6, Devil 7. 18 Devil 8. 20 Moon 7. 21 Tower 6. 25 Devil 9. 28 Tower 7.

September. 1 Justice 9, Devil 10. 3 Justice 10. 6 Sun 1 at the shrine on Sunday after returning the fountain pen. 7 Lovers 2. 9 Strength 9. 10 Lovers 3. 11 Temperance 6. 12 Strength 10. 14 Priestess 8. 15 Fortune 2. 16 Temperance 7. 17 Fortune 3, Tower 8. 24 Fortune 4, Tower 9. 25 Temperance 8. 28 Priestess 9. 29 Fortune 5. 30 Emperor 8. Rescue @npc{Bunkichi} in Tartarus by October 4.

October. 1 Fortune 6. 3 Priestess 10. 7 Star 3. 8 Moon 8. 9 Star 4. 10 Moon 9. 11 Sun 2. 12 Hermit 10. 17 Hierophant 6. 18 Sun 3. 19 Emperor 9. 20 Fortune 7. 21 Temperance 9. 22 Magician 9. 23 Magician 10, Tower 10. 24 Hierophant 7. 26 Lovers 4. 27 Fortune 8. 28 Lovers 5. 29 Lovers 6. 30 Emperor 10. 31 Lovers 7. Sun meetings only happen on Sundays.

November. 1 Sun 4. 2 Lovers 8. 6 Chariot 5. 8 Sun 5. 10 Chariot 6. 11 Lovers 9. 12 Lovers 10. 13 Chariot 7. 15 Sun 6. 16 Chariot 8. 21 Empress 1. 22 Sun 7. 23 Hanged Man 8. 28 Empress 2. 29 Hierophant 8. 30 Empress 3. Rescue @npc{Maiko} in Tartarus by November 3.

December. 2 Temperance 10. 4 Empress 4. 5 Hanged Man 9. 6 Sun 8. 7 Empress 5. 8 Hierophant 9. 9 Empress 6. 10 Empress 7. 11 Star 5. 12 Hanged Man 10. 13 Star 6. 20 Sun 9. 21 Empress 8. 22 Empress 9. 23 Hierophant 10. 25 Chariot 9. 26 Moon 10. 27 Sun 10. 30 Star 7. Spare Ryoji on December 31 to open Judgement.

January. 3 Star 8. 8 Aeon 1 in Classroom 2-F. 9 Empress 10. 10 Star 9. 12 Chariot 10. 13 Aeon 2. 14 Fortune 9. 15 Aeon 3. 16 Aeon 4. 17 Star 10. 20 Aeon 5. 22 Aeon 6. 23 Aeon 7. 26 Fortune 10. 27 Aeon 8. 28 Aeon 9. 29 Aeon 10. Advance Judgement by climbing Tartarus, and finish everything before January 31.
Save regularly, and before June 9 and October 7 in particular. If a stat is behind schedule then, replace part-time work and dorm hangouts with arcade, burger or Wakatsu visits to catch up.

achievements.description: Unlocked all Social Links.
achievements.summary: Start every Social Link in a single playthrough.

guide.context: Save before December 31 and spare Ryoji to keep January playable; reload that save after the other choice. Rescue Bunkichi in Tartarus by October 4 and Maiko by November 3 to keep their links open.

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.name: Tower — Mutatsu

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.name: Star — Mamoru
collectibles.location: From August 5, meet Mamoru at Iwatodai Strip Mall with Courage rank 4.
collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

collectibles.name: Sun — Akinari

collectibles.method: Reach rank 1 in this Social Link.

achievements.description: Nurtured a romance.
achievements.summary: Begin a romantic relationship with a Social Link partner.

steps.text: With @mechanic{Charm rank 6}, start Yukari’s Social Link in Classroom 2-F from July 25.
When Yukari advances from rank 6 to 7, choose @mechanic{Let’s go just the two of us.}
Save before her rank 9 event, then choose @mechanic{I love you.} Reload that save if you choose the friendship answer.

achievements.description: Maxed out one Social Link.
achievements.summary: Raise one Social Link to rank 10.

steps.text: Start @npc{Tanaka} at Paulownia Mall: reach Hermit rank 4 and Charm rank 4, then pay 20,000 yen followed by 10,000 yen on each of two later visits.
Meet Tanaka on Tuesday or Saturday evenings until the @mechanic{Devil Social Link} reaches rank 10; any dialogue answers work.

achievements.description: Awaken every teammate's ultimate Persona.
achievements.summary: Awaken every teammate's ultimate Persona.

steps.text: Reach the December 30 story event to finish the teammate Persona awakenings.

achievements.description: Obtained 10 Personas during Shuffle Time.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Acquire 10 Personas through Shuffle Time in the main story.

steps.text: Select Persona cards in @mechanic{Shuffle Time} until you have received 10 Personas.
Keep space for new Personas; a card matching a Persona you already carry adds no credit.

achievements.description: Performed a Shift.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Pass an extra turn to a teammate with Shift in the main story.

steps.text: Hit an enemy’s weakness, then choose @mechanic{Shift} and pass the extra turn to a teammate.

achievements.description: Used all teammates' Theurgy.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Use at least one Theurgy for every teammate in the main story.

steps.text: From June 13, use one @mechanic{Theurgy} with every teammate as they join, including Fuuka’s support Theurgy. Only one Theurgy per person is needed.
Put @npc{Shinjiro} in your party during September and use his Theurgy @warn{before October 4}.

achievements.description: Rescued a missing person.
achievements.summary: Bring a missing person safely out of Tartarus.

steps.text: Between June 18 and July 6, find @npc{Ayako Yoshimoto} on @loc{Tartarus 50F} and escort her to the entrance.

achievements.displayName: Get a Load of Those Numbers!
achievements.description: Dealt over 999 damage in a single attack (All-Out Attacks excluded).(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Deal at least 1,000 damage with one attack other than an All-Out Attack in the main story.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Tarukaja} on your attacker and @mechanic{Rakunda} on the enemy, then land a strong Theurgy attack for at least 1,000 damage.

achievements.description: Initiated 50 Chance Encounters.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Start 50 battles with a Chance Encounter advantage in the main story.

steps.text: Approach Shadows from behind in @loc{Tartarus} and strike before they notice you; start 50 battles with the advantage.

achievements.description: Defeated a rare, golden enemy.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Defeat a golden rare Shadow in the main story.

steps.text: Chase a golden hand Shadow in @loc{Tartarus}, start the fight and defeat the enemy before it flees. Use Theurgy if available.

achievements.description: Performed 50 All-Out Attacks.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Execute 50 All-Out Attacks in the main story.

steps.text: Knock down every enemy with weakness hits or critical hits, then accept the @mechanic{All-Out Attack} prompt. Do this in 50 battles.

achievements.description: Discovered and conquered 10 Monad doors.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Clear 10 Monad Doors in the main story.

steps.text: When Fuuka detects a @loc{Monad Door}, enter, defeat the boss and collect the treasure at the back. Clear 10 doors this way.

achievements.description: Opened 50 treasure chests.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Loot 50 treasure chests in the main story.

steps.text: Open chests while exploring @loc{Tartarus} until you have looted 50.

achievements.description: Used a total of 50 Twilight Fragments.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Spend a total of 50 Twilight Fragments in the main story.

steps.text: Collect @item{Twilight Fragments} from town and blue breakable objects in Tartarus.
Spend 50 in total on locked chests or healing at the entrance clock.

achievements.description: Encountered a Dark Zone in Tartarus.
achievements.summary: Find a random Dark Zone in Tartarus.

steps.text: After the @loc{Tziah} Dark Zone tutorial, keep exploring Tartarus until a random floor becomes a @mechanic{Dark Zone}.

achievements.description: Defeated the Reaper.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Defeat the Reaper in the main story.

steps.text: Prepare a party around level 80 or higher. Use @mechanic{Peaceful} difficulty if you want unlimited revives.
Wait about five minutes on one Tartarus floor for @enemy{the Reaper}, then defeat it.

achievements.description: Performed a Dyad Fusion.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Create a Persona through Dyad Fusion in the main story.

steps.text: In the @loc{Velvet Room}, choose @mechanic{Dyad Fusion} and combine two Personas.

achievements.description: Performed a fusion with three or more Personas.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Fuse a Persona using at least three ingredients in the main story.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Special Fusion} in the Velvet Room and choose an available recipe with at least three ingredients.
Acquire the listed Personas, return to the Velvet Room and complete that fusion.

achievements.description: Obtained an item from a Persona Conception.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Receive a Persona Conception item in the main story.

steps.text: Check your Personas for a heart icon, then keep a heart-marked Persona equipped while earning experience.
Level that Persona until it produces its @item{Persona Conception} item.

achievements.description: Fused Messiah.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Create Messiah by fusion in the main story.

steps.text: Spare Ryoji on December 31 and climb Tartarus during January until the @mechanic{Judgement Social Link} reaches its maximum rank.
Reach level 91, or level 86 with the @mechanic{Sun Major Arcana} fusion benefit.
Use Special Fusion to make @item{Alice} from Pixie, Lilim, Narcissus and Titania. Then fuse @item{Thanatos} from Pisaca, Pale Rider, Loa, Samael, Mot and Alice.
Fuse @item{Orpheus} with Thanatos to create @item{Messiah} before the January 31 final battle.

achievements.description: Triggered a skill change during fusion.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Accept a fusion skill change in the main story.

steps.text: Keep fusing Personas in the @loc{Velvet Room}; when a skill-change prompt appears, agree to the change.

achievements.description: Harvested a crop that you grew with a teammate.
achievements.summary: Harvest a crop tended with a teammate.

steps.text: From June 16, spend a gardening evening with @npc{Fuuka} at the dorm rooftop planters.
When that crop is ready, return to the planters and harvest it.

achievements.description: Earned over 50,000 yen total from part-time jobs.
achievements.summary: Earn more than 50,000 yen in cumulative part-time wages.

steps.text: Work shifts at the cafe or @loc{Be Blue V} in Paulownia Mall, or the cinema at Port Island Station.
Keep taking shifts until total wages exceed 50,000 yen.

achievements.description: Maxed out one Social Stat.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum rank in a Social Stat.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Courage}, @mechanic{Charm} or @mechanic{Academics} to its maximum rank through meals, jobs, arcade games or studying.

achievements.description: Maxed out all Social Stats.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum rank in Courage, Charm and Academics.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Courage} and @mechanic{Charm} through evening meals, arcade games and part-time jobs. Correct classroom answers also raise Charm.
Study to build @mechanic{Academics}. Keep raising each Social Stat until Courage, Charm and Academics are all at their maximum rank.

achievements.description: Spent an evening in the dorm with a teammate.
achievements.summary: Spend an evening doing a dorm activity with a teammate.

steps.text: From June 13, spend an evening cooking, reading, watching TV or gardening with a teammate at the dorm.

achievements.description: Ordered from a secret menu at the Iwatodai strip mall at night.
achievements.summary: Order a secret-menu meal at Iwatodai Strip Mall at night.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{Charm rank 3}, then visit @loc{Wakatsu Kitchen} in Iwatodai Strip Mall at night and order @item{Seafood Full Course}.

achievements.description: Nursed a cat back to full health.
achievements.summary: Restore the weak cat to full health.

steps.text: Accept @mechanic{Elizabeth request 42} and buy four @item{Super Cat Food} from Aohige Pharmacy.
Feed the @npc{Weak Cat} at Port Island Station’s @loc{Station Outskirts} on four separate days.

achievements.description: Accepted an invitation to hang out five times.
achievements.summary: Accept five invitations to spend time together.

steps.text: On days without school, check messages from Social Link friends and accept their invitations to hang out. Complete five invited meetings.

achievements.description: Unlocked access to the remaining Major Arcana.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Collect the treasure at the end of Tartarus 91F’s fixed Monad passage.

steps.text: Enter the fixed @loc{Monad passage on Tartarus 91F}, defeat both bosses and take the treasure. If the fight is too hard, return after leveling up.

achievements.description: Unlocked a teammate's Combat Characteristic.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Unlock a teammate’s Combat Characteristic.

steps.text: Spend three evenings doing the same dorm activity with the same teammate, such as cooking with Yukari.

achievements.description: Acquired every Twilight Fragment in town.(Persona 3 Reload main story mode only)
achievements.summary: Collect all 17 Twilight Fragments scattered around town in the main story.

guide.context: The dorm rooftop opens May 25. Club Escapade requires Courage rank 2.
